The customer is responsible for carrying out all regular scheduled maintenance services at every 20,000/25,000 km* or every one year (12 months) *, whichever comes first, as recommended by the manufacturer for the United Arab Emirates.

The scheduled service must be carried out at an Authorized Mercedes-Benz Service Centre operated by Gargash Enterprises in Dubai, Sharjah and Northern Emirates in the United Arab Emirates. Additional scope of maintenance services*, which are defined by the manufacturer or its representative, are also to be carried out as recommended.

It is the responsibility of the customer to provide proof of invoice/document for maintenance carried out at the Authorized Mercedes-Benz Service Centre, upon request.

Failure to comply with aforementioned maintenance requirements may void the Gargash Extended Warranty Program on the vehicle.

Which Mercedes-Benz models do you repair?

The full Mercedes-Benz passenger range: everyday models from the A-Class to the S-Class, SUVs from the GLA to the G-Class, AMG, Maybach, Mercedes-EQ electric models, classic Mercedes-Benz and the SLR McLaren.

Do you use genuine Mercedes-Benz parts for repairs?

Yes. Repairs use genuine Mercedes-Benz parts and approved fluids, fitted to Mercedes-Benz repair procedures by factory-trained technicians.

Is there a warranty on repair work?

Yes. All repair, servicing and maintenance work is covered by a 12-month warranty on parts and labour. Terms and conditions apply.

Can you collect my car for repair?

Yes. We offer complimentary collection and delivery across Dubai, so you don't need to bring the car to Al Quoz yourself.

How do you find the cause of a fault?

We start with a full XENTRY scan of every control unit, then follow Mercedes-Benz guided test procedures to confirm the faulty component before recommending a repair, so you only pay to fix what is actually wrong.

We suggest oil and filter every 10,000 km for cars driven hard through the summer.

How much does a Mercedes service cost in Dubai?

For a standard Service A, AED 650 to AED 950. Service B runs AED 950 to AED 1,500 on a C-Class or E-Class, and AED 1,250 to AED 2,000 on AMG cars. A full computer diagnostic is AED 250, deducted from the bill if you go ahead with the work. That sits 30-50% below authorised dealer pricing for the same job.

Will servicing here void my Mercedes warranty?

Servicing at an independent specialist does not automatically void a manufacturer warranty, provided the correct oil specification and filter quality are used, the schedule is followed, and the work is documented. We record everything and stamp your service book. If your car is still inside its warranty period, read your agreement first. Warranty terms depend on the repair and are confirmed in writing with your quote.

Can you reset the ASSYST service indicator?

Yes. ASSYST and ASSYST PLUS are reset through the vehicle's own instrument cluster menu once the service is completed, so the counter restarts from the correct date and mileage. We do it as part of every Mercedes service in Dubai, not as a paid extra. If a previous workshop reset the indicator without changing the oil, we will tell you what we find.

Do you work with insurance companies?

No. We do not work with insurance companies. That means no invoices inflated to satisfy an assessor, no weeks of waiting for approval, and no repair scope decided by somebody else's budget. You get a direct written quote, you approve it, and we carry out the work. It is also a large part of why our prices sit 30-50% below the dealer.

Where is your workshop and can you collect my car?

Our workshop is in Dubai Investment Park 1, and we service Mercedes-Benz owners across Dubai, from Downtown, Business Bay and Jumeirah to Marina, JLT, Mirdif and Dubai Hills. Vehicle collection and return is available across Dubai on request. We are open Monday to Saturday, 8:00am to 7:00pm, and closed on Sunday. WhatsApp us on 052 344 3501 to arrange a time.
